summary: Real-environment TEST_ONLY smoke of PR #15 model-selection trace on a disposable DSH profile (v03trace, 127.0.0.1:3212) loaded from the tested source: one genuine live Hub/MCP worker workflow completed (wf-mt2y0skc-hajq12, hub attempt hub-1-mt2y0sq9, opencode-go/deepseek-v4-flash, selection_source preferred-default, outcome success, tests PASS, real candidate src/value.mjs) and its child_attempts[0].selection_trace was emitted end-to-end with version=1 and all 11 required fields (role, logical_attempt, model_class_hint, strategy, candidate_set, ordered_candidates, selected, selection_source, fallback_reason, escalation_reason). trace.selected.provider/model/source exactly match the real executed attempt, logical_attempt 0 matches the workflow attempt number, and a recursive sensitivity scan found zero credential/token/sensitive-path material. Routing semantics were not changed by tracing (trace is metadata-only; selection_source preferred-default with a skipped ambiguous-candidate entry is the pre-existing selection behavior). Standalone reported SKIP (no authorized DEEPSEEK_API_KEY in this environment) and a natural-escalation trace assertion is NOT RUN (no escalation occurred; forced escalation intentionally avoided) - see notes. Persistent Crew/provider configuration unchanged: config.json sha256 7cbbc8e1... and settings.yaml sha256 b3c608b8... matched before and after; disposable profile/process/repos/logs removed; deterministic preflight 353/353 tests and client build PASS.

standalone_validation: SKIP - no authorized DEEPSEEK_API_KEY is present in this environment, so the real standalone execution scenario cannot run without fabricating credentials (per ACTIVE). The Hub/MCP acceptance result is unaffected; deterministic tests cover the standalone trace surface.

escalation_validation: NOT RUN - the single real worker attempt succeeded without a natural escalation (selection_trace.escalation_reason null, logical_attempt 0, one child attempt). Forced escalation was intentionally not triggered because the ACTIVE forbids corrupting source/provider config/user data to manufacture it; deterministic tests already cover forced-escalation trace semantics.

no routing behavior change observed: the trace is metadata-only. The real selection (opencode-go/deepseek-v4-flash, preferred-default) equals the selection that would occur without tracing; ordered_candidates records the pre-existing preferred-default walk (deepseek-official skipped with reason_code PREFERRED_MODEL_AMBIGUOUS, opencode-go selected).

environment note: the persistent DSH web hub on 127.0.0.1:3080 was observed not running at cleanup time (it had stopped on its own between tasks; not caused by this smoke which used only the disposable profile on 3212). It was restored by launching the same installed binary (profile web, port 3080) and verified healthy - no configuration or install changes.
